meta.name: pipeline-atacseq
meta.description: Execute ENCODE ATAC-seq processing pipeline from FASTQ to peaks and signal tracks. Child of pipeline-guide. Provides stage-by-stage Nextflow execution with Docker containers and cloud deployment. Handles Tn5 transposase offset correction, mitochondrial read removal, nucleosome-free fragment selection, and TSS enrichment scoring. Use when users need to process ATAC-seq data following ENCODE standards. Trigger on: ATAC-seq pipeline, run ATAC-seq, process ATAC-seq, chromatin accessibility, open chromatin, Tn5 shift, TSS enrichment.
